function: Learned (LLM in-context) scheduling of sensor data collection and UAV velocity to minimize Age of Information; no physical-layer function. p. 5.
notes: above_phy: the pre-trained LLM, prompted in context and not fine-tuned (p. 7, Table I), only selects the sensor to serve and the UAV velocity. p. 5: "jointly optimizing the UAV velocity v(t) and data collection schedule A(t)". Transmit power and beams are not learned. The preprint prints no DOI, so the DOI was not checked against the PDF; p. 1 states acceptance by IEEE Internet of Things Journal.
